title: 730. Candy Crush

examples.explanation: The top row triple and left column triple crush to 0, then survivors fall down leaving rows 0002, 0322 and 0231.
No row or column holds three equal non-zero values, so the board is already stable.
One horizontal triple crushes and nothing falls.

hints: Repeat two phases until stable: mark every horizontal or vertical run of 3+ equal non-zero cells, then apply gravity per column.
Mark before crushing so overlapping crosses disappear together; '0' means empty and never forms a run.

Drop each column by compacting non-zero values to the bottom and filling the top with zeros, then re-encode each row as one string. Adaptation: input is char_array_2d with digits '0'-'5' and output is string_list of row strings; Rust receives the board as its encoded string.
